title: Chess Piece Validator
description: Build a chess move validator that validates moves for all piece types and detects check conditions.

steps.title: Create the chess board
steps.description: Define the `board` as an 8x8 2D array. Use objects with `type` (pawn, rook, etc.) and `color` (white, black). Set up the standard starting position and log it.
hints: Use null for empty squares, objects for pieces: { type: 'pawn', color: 'white' }
Back row (rank 1): rook, knight, bishop, queen, king, bishop, knight, rook

verification.successMessage: Chess board set up with standard starting position!
verification.failureMessage: createBoard should return an 8x8 board with pieces in starting positions.

steps.title: Validate pawn moves
steps.description: Write a `isValidPawnMove` function that takes the board, start position, and end position, and returns true if the pawn move is valid. Include forward movement, double move from starting rank, and diagonal captures.
hints: White pawns move up (y decreasing), black pawns move down (y increasing)
Forward one: same x, y +/- 1, target must be empty
Double move from start: same x, y +/- 2, both squares must be empty
Capture: diagonal x +/- 1, y +/- 1, target must have opposite color

verification.test: output.includes('Pawn forward: true') && output.includes('Pawn double: true')
verification.successMessage: Pawn movement validates forward and double moves correctly!
verification.failureMessage: isValidPawnMove should return true for forward 1 square and double move from starting rank for a white pawn.

steps.title: Validate rook and bishop moves
steps.description: Write `isValidRookMove` and `isValidBishopMove` functions. Rooks move horizontally/vertically. Bishops move diagonally. Check that the path is clear. Log test results.
hints: Rook: same row (y) or same column (x), no pieces between
Loop through intermediate squares to ensure they are empty

verification.test: output.includes('Rook vertical: true') && output.includes('Bishop diagonal: true')
verification.successMessage: Rook and bishop moves validate correctly!
verification.failureMessage: isValidRookMove should return true for moving down an open column. isValidBishopMove should return true for moving along an open diagonal.

steps.title: Validate queen and knight moves
steps.description: Write `isValidQueenMove` (combines rook + bishop) and `isValidKnightMove` (L-shape: 2+1 or 1+2). Log test results.
hints: Queen: reuse rook and bishop logic (or same combined check)
Knight can jump over pieces (no need to check path)

verification.test: output.includes('Queen diagonal: true') && output.includes('Knight L-shape: true')
verification.successMessage: Queen and knight moves validate correctly!
verification.failureMessage: isValidQueenMove should work like rook+bishop. isValidKnightMove should validate L-shaped movement.

steps.title: Validate king moves and detect check
steps.description: Write `isValidKingMove` (1 square any direction) and `isInCheck` function that checks if a given king is under attack by any opposing piece. Log the check status.
hints: isInCheck: find the king's position, then check if any opponent piece can reach it
Use all the isValid* functions to check each opponent piece

verification.successMessage: King movement validates correctly and check detection works!
verification.failureMessage: isValidKingMove(4, 7, 4, 6) should be true. isInCheck should detect that the black rook on the same column puts the white king in check.
